content: No, that is not accurate. EU/EFTA cross-border commuters do not have to return home every day, and they are not restricted to living only in specific border zones to work in Switzerland. Cross-border commuting is a common practice in the region, facilitated by the free movement provisions of the EU/EFTA-Swiss bilateral agreements. These agreements allow citizens of EU/EFTA countries to live in one country and work in another, including Switzerland, without needing special permits for daily commuting. The only requirement is usually to maintain a residence in their home country.
